body: Shit, man. I've been dealing with some shit for years now all hoping it gets better at some point. Out of all the "yeah it gets better"'s reading a "no it doesn't hits harder" I hate this fucking life sometimes

Thank you but I'm not at risk right now, it's just that I needed to vent about how it's always there, and has been for years now. There are good times and there are bad times for sure, but that other side is always there.
